title: Matchings and shape-Wilf-Equivalence of sets of patterns of length three II: Quadruples and Quintuples
summary: Building on our classification of shape-Wilf-equivalence classes for triples of patterns of length three, we complete the classification for quadruples and quintuples. The larger pattern sets exhibit structural features that are not captured by the encoding methods used for triples and require additional combinatorial tools. Our main new ingredient is a Dyck-path approach to Ferrers boards containing the staircase board.
